message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && rm -f /tmp/mrbobj/*.o
count=0; fail=0
for pi in $(find build/host -name "*.pi"); do
  base=$(echo "$pi" | sed 's|build/host/||;s|/|_|g;s|\.pi||')
  out="/tmp/mrbobj/${base}.o"
  if gcc -c -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DMRB_USE_RATIONAL -DMRB_USE_COMPLEX -x c "$pi" -o "$out" 2>/tmp/err.txt; then
    count=$((count+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL: $pi"; head -3 /tmp/err.txt
  fi
done
echo "compiled=$count failed=$fail"
ls /tmp/mrbobj/ | wc -l

message.content: The `.pi` extension is being treated as a linker input. I need to force the language with `-x c`.
